Job Function: Finance and Accounting
Job Family: General Accounting
 
Key Responsibilities
Cash Application

Match incoming customer payments of every kind to the right invoices in the ERP each day.
Investigate and clear unmatched receipts, short and over payments and remittance gaps.
Book deductions and credits and pass disputes to Sales or Customer Service.
Agree daily receipts with the bank.

Accounts Receivable

Issue customer invoices and statements correctly and on time.
Watch the AR ageing and chase overdue accounts by phone and email.
Keep customer records, credit notes and collection notes up to date.
Support credit reviews and propose holds or write-offs.
Help bring down Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and bad debt.

Accounts Payable

Check and enter supplier invoices against purchase orders and receipts (2-way and 3-way match).
Get the right approvals and code invoices to the right GL accounts.
Prepare and run the scheduled payment batches.
Keep supplier master data and bank details correct, with fraud checks in place.
Answer supplier questions and agree supplier statements.

Month-End and General Accounting

Agree the AR and AP subledgers with the general ledger every month.
Prepare accruals, ageing reports and schedules for the month-end close.
